prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'EchoSystems Chrono Compendium v1.0' (chunk 14.86) about time: is view does not simply hold that history is an unchangeable constant, but that any change made by a hypothetical futur
true_answer: is view does not simply hold that history is an unchangeable constant, but that any change made by a hypothetical future time traveller would already have happened in their past, resulting in the reality that the traveller moves from. e Novikov self- consistency principle asserts that due to causality constraints, time travel to the past is impossible. e specious present refers to the time duration wherein one's perceptions are considered to be in the present.
